script: How to export food? Rina's first pickle shipment got stuck at port.
No health certificate. Food exports need one, often from BFSA.
Second try: trade licence, ERC, BIN, then buyer rules, like US FDA registration.
Labels, invoice, packing list, origin certificate. Cleared!
Then list your food on Exportain and let buyers find you.
